gsm_gen_rk_compute = {
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkt value = gsm_t_rkv }
	multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkt value = @gsm_rank_scale }
	divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkt value = @gsm_hurdle_roa }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rklo value = @gsm_rank_scale }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkhi value = @gsm_rank_scale }
	multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkhi value = 1.25 }
	while = {
		count = @gsm_rank_bisect
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkmd value = gsm_t_rklo }
		change_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkmd value = gsm_t_rkhi }
		divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkmd value = 2 }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp2 value = gsm_t_rkmd } multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp2 value = gsm_t_rkmd } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp2 value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp4 value = gsm_t_rkp2 } multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp4 value = gsm_t_rkp2 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp4 value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp8 value = gsm_t_rkp4 } multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp8 value = gsm_t_rkp4 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkp8 value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkp8 } multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkp8 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkp8 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkp4 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkp2 } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = gsm_t_rkmd } divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value = @gsm_rank_scale }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkpp value >= gsm_t_rkt } } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkhi value = gsm_t_rkmd } } else = { set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rklo value = gsm_t_rkmd } }
	}
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rkr value = gsm_t_rkhi }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rke_8 value = @gsm_hurdle_roa } multiply_variable = { which = gsm_t_rke_8 value = @gsm_rank_scale }

gsm_gen_walk_write = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wk value = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wwm value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wwr value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = gsm_rv_energy value = gsm_t_wwv } }
			set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rbo value = -1 }
			if = { limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_rb_energy } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_rbo value = gsm_rb_energy } }
			set_variable = { which = gsm_rb_energy value = gsm_t_rbn }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wbf value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = gsm_rbf_energy value = 1 } set_variable = { which = gsm_rvfv_energy value = gsm_t_wvf } } else = { if = { limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_rbf_energy } clear_variable = gsm_rbf_energy } if = { limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_rvfv_energy } clear_variable = gsm_rvfv_energy } }
			if = { limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_rbw_energy } clear_variable = gsm_rbw_energy }
			if = { limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_rbp_energy } clear_variable = gsm_rbp_energy }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wwg value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = gsm_rw_energy value = event_target:gsm_exchange.gsm_month } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_wwg value = 2 } is_variable_set = gsm_rw_energy } clear_variable = gsm_rw_energy }
